record.original_question: Let X be a projective hyperkahler manifold. If z in CH(X) is a Chow class that is a polynomial in divisor classes D1, ..., Dk from Pic(X) and in the Chern classes c_i(X), and if the cohomology class of z vanishes in H^*(X, Z), must z already vanish in the Chow ring?

evidence.quote: A different issue concerns the Chow ring of a projective hyperkahler manifold. In [6] and [37] the following conjecture is proposed:
Conjecture 3. Let D1,...,Dk in Pic(X), and let z in CH(X) be a class which is a polynomial in D1,...,Dk and the Chern classes c_i(X). If z = 0 in H^*(X,Z), then z = 0.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a projective hyperkähler manifold, that is, a simply connected smooth complex projective variety such that $H^0(X,\Omega_X^2)$ is generated by a nowhere degenerate holomorphic 2-form. Let $\mathrm{CH}(X)=\bigoplus_i \mathrm{CH}^i(X)$ denote the Chow ring of $X$ with rational (or integral) coefficients, and let $\mathrm{cl}\colon \mathrm{CH}(X)\to H^*(X,\mathbb{Z})$ be the cycle class map. Let $\mathrm{Pic}(X)\subset \mathrm{CH}^1(X)$ be the Picard group, and let $c_i(X)\in \mathrm{CH}^i(X)$ denote the Chern classes of the tangent bundle of $X$.

Prove or disprove: for every choice of divisor classes $D_1,\ldots,D_k\in \mathrm{Pic}(X)$ and every class $z\in \mathrm{CH}(X)$ that can be written as a polynomial in $D_1,\ldots,D_k$ and $c_1(X),c_2(X),\ldots$, the implication
$$\mathrm{cl}(z)=0 \text{ in } H^*(X,\mathbb{Z}) \quad \Longrightarrow \quad z=0 \text{ in } \mathrm{CH}(X)$$
holds. Equivalently, the subring of $\mathrm{CH}(X)$ generated by $\mathrm{Pic}(X)$ and the Chern classes of $T_X$ injects into the cohomology ring of $X$ via the cycle class map.
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture remains open in general for arbitrary projective hyperkähler manifolds. It has been verified in several special cases: for K3 surfaces (Beauville–Voisin), for Hilbert schemes of points on K3 surfaces in certain ranges, for generalized Kummer varieties, for Fano varieties of lines on cubic fourfolds, for double EPW sextics, and for LLSS eightfolds (zero-cycles), via work of Voisin, Fu, Tian, Vial, and others.

status_evidence.title: On the Chow ring of certain algebraic hyper-Kähler manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Voisin formulates and proves a weak version of the conjecture for Hilbert schemes of K3 surfaces and Fano varieties of lines on cubic fourfolds.
status_evidence.claim: Conjecture established in special cases (Hilbert schemes of K3, Fano varieties of lines on cubic fourfolds).

status_evidence.title: The Beauville–Voisin conjecture for double EPW sextics
status_evidence.snippet: The Beauville–Voisin conjecture is proven for any double EPW sextic.
status_evidence.claim: Conjecture verified for double EPW sextics.

status_evidence.title: Lehn's formula in Chow and Conjectures of Beauville and Voisin
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes a generalized version of the Beauville–Voisin conjecture in additional cases.
status_evidence.claim: Further partial progress in additional hyperkähler families.

status_evidence.title: Beauville-Voisin Conjecture for Generalized Kummer Varieties
status_evidence.snippet: Conjecture proved for generalized Kummer varieties.
